newsitem.title: USA: Polycom to buy ViaVideo in $37.6 mln deal.
newsitem.headline: Polycom to buy ViaVideo in $37.6 mln deal.

text.p: Polycom, Inc. said on Wednesday it had agreed to buy videoconferencing firm ViaVideo Communications, Inc. for 9.7 million in new shares of Polycom common stock in a deal valued at $37.6 million.
The deal is subject to shareholder approval and other conditions and is expected to close in the first quarter of 1998.
Common stock of Polycom, which makes audioconferencing products and conference data sharing capabilities, closed on Wednesday at $3.875.
The total number of Polycom shares to be issued may be reduced so the total acquisition consideration does not exceed $90 million, the companies said in a statement.

These closing conditions include first customer shipment by ViaVideo of its initial videoconferencing system no later than March 31, 1998 and Polycom's share price preceding the acquisition to be at or above $3.00.
